name: Alend
sources: Gwynn, Edward. The Metrical Dindshenchas. Part II. Vol. IX. Royal Irish Academy, Todd Lecture Series. Dublin: Hodges, Figgis, and Co., Ltd., 1906–1924, 81+.

attributes.attribute: old capital of Leinster, named for her
the hill where the capital stood

text: Alend is an Irish goddess or heroine. The great city Almu, the old capital of the eastern province of Leinster, took its name from her. Writers called her royal and heroic but gave little story to say why. The hill where the capital stood is now the Hill of Allen in County Kildare. The goddess also lent her name to the Bog of Allen.
